basis.en: First published in 1890; the author died in 1939.
basis.zh: 1890 年首次发表；作者卒于 1939 年。

note.en: Yeats wrote it in London in 1888, homesick, after a small fountain in a shop window reminded him of lake water; it was first published in 1890. The poem is a plan, nine bean rows and a hive, made by someone standing on grey pavement. The last line, “in the deep heart’s core”, is where the lake actually is.
note.zh: 1888 年叶芝在伦敦思乡，商店橱窗里一个小喷泉让他想起湖水，于是写下这首诗，1890 年首次发表。诗是一份计划——九垄豆子，一个蜂巢——由一个站在灰色人行道上的人拟定。最后一行“在内心最深处”，才是那片湖真正所在的地方。

excerpt.orig: And I shall have some peace there, for peace comes dropping slow,
excerpt.en: And I shall have some peace there, for peace comes dropping slow,
excerpt.zh: 我会在那里得到一些安宁，因为安宁慢慢滴落，
